title: The princess and the plans
description: Astromech Droid R2-D2 carries within him stolen technical readouts of the Death Star battle station. He, along with his Protocol Droid counterpart C-3PO, manages to escape the eager clutches of Darth Vader. Both land on the desert planet Tatooine, and are soon captured by Jawas; eventually finding themselves on Owen Lars' moisture farm. There they encounter and befriend young Luke Skywalker, who begins to suspect that there's more to these newly-purchased Droids than meets the eye...
